I think there was something weird baked into that pie..
Here's my first Toriel vore sequence. AI really struggles with making vore still, but I'll probably make more in the future. It's going to take a while since AI is bad with vore and I'm using an old 1660 graphics card, so each generation takes a long time. I spent a lot of time trying to get it to make good unbirthing scenes, but I couldnt manage to get anything worth sharing.
